description: Phase-1 strict-policy rollout for the no-op-promise scoreboard (Cycle 22). --strict fails on any enforced-class finding not covered by a live, unexpired allowlist entry, and on any stale allowlist entry. Report-only scoreboard is unchanged.

rules.text: --strict fails on any enforced-class finding with no matching live allowlist entry. New code must be clean or explicitly allowlisted with a reason and review date.
Every allowlist entry carries a review date (<= 90 days out). An entry past its review date fails --strict until re-reviewed.
An allowlist entry matching no live finding (file+class+line) fails --strict. Line-exact matching is deliberate: moving code near a swallow re-triggers review.
noop-catch-named and noop-then-fulfillment have zero live findings; any new one fails --strict immediately.
The 10 undocumented swallows (category E) carry 30-day review dates (2026-11-18). Each must gain an in-code justification or be fixed before its review date.
